verdict.rationale: SerpApi returns its search results in open formats (JSON, raw HTML, Markdown). It documents a Searches Archive API for retrieving past results, and plans are month-to-month with cancel-anytime, so a user can pull results out and leave. There is no documented bulk account-data export, and the archive API is described only in the context of retrieving async searches. missing for 10: documented bulk export of all account data (search history, account and billing records), explicit data-portability or deletion-on-exit documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of a full export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: It can be set to `json` (default) to get a structured JSON of the results, `html` to get the raw HTML retrieved, or `md` to get a markdown-formatted version optimized for LLMs and AI agents.
you'll need to use our Searches Archive API to retrieve your results
